item.title: Did not see results from terminal
item.body:
Type: Bug I asked the agent to build x, it suggested installing Y, but I asked it to use the virtual environmnet first. It them started putting bash commands into a Powewr shell terminal. Timed out. It used the virtual environment, and the tried to get a directory listing (using bash commands) and that timed out. It added the powershell commands, executed them, and kept waiting for the output despite it being clearly present in the terminal. GitHub Copilot I'll help you activate the virtual environment. Let me first check what's in your OpenHandsMCP directory and then activate the appropriate virtual environment. Read OpenHandsMCP I can see there's a venv directory. Let me activate the virtual environment for you: Let me use the correct PowerShell syntax: cd d:\dev\OpenHandsMCP; .\venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1 Perfect! The virtual environment is now activated (you can see the (venv) prefix).
